actuator.meaning: Legacy selector; the standing stop reads it from the envelope top level, so callers mirror this payload field there.

metadata.meaning: Required legacy object at the envelope top level, mirrored from the payload. It may be empty: this stop does not read any members. The whole request is bounded at 16384 bytes.

buckets.meaning: One run-state row for each configured bucket.

running.meaning: The unit is running or in an in-flight activation, deactivation, or reload state.

last_run_at.meaning: Integer seconds of the last observable finished run, or null.

last_run_ok.meaning: Whether systemd reported success for that run, or null when no result can be read.

connected.meaning: Status does not check connection; this field is always null.

step.meaning: Failing phase, present on the stop's refusal.
